name: game-prototype
description: > Invoke when the user wants to rapidly prototype a mechanic, test a proof of concept, run hypothesis-driven development, or validate a game idea before full production. Triggers on: "prototype", "proof of concept", "test this mechanic", "validate idea", "rapid prototype", "bake-off". Do NOT invoke for starting a full project (use game-start) or brainstorming concepts (use game-brainstorm). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
author: AlterLab-IEU
